title: PNG Stalkers
body:
PNG Stalkers

PNG Stalkers is a Minecraft horror mod that adds creepy PNG-style entities that stalk, watch, chase, and scare the player.

This mod is built around unsettling encounters instead of normal mobs. Some stalkers appear in the distance, some creep near windows or doors, and others chase the player with eerie sounds and darkness effects.

Features
Multiple PNG Stalker entities
Jester variants, including Jester Grin and Twixels Jester
Window Peek Jester encounter
Door Jester encounter
Door Jester spawns outside the door instead of inside the player
Creepy scare PNG appearances
Stalkers can chase and attack the player
Darkness effect for a horror-style limited view
Chase sounds, hurt sounds, and scare sounds
Random music moments using the included creepy tracks
Stalkers can naturally appear over time
Spawn commands included for testing or custom maps
Works great for horror survival worlds, videos, and servers
Compatibility

Made for:


Minecraft Forge 1.20.1


This mod is compatible with server-side gameplay, but for the full experience with textures and sounds, players should also have the mod installed on their client.

Commands

/function pngstalksafe:spawn/red_stalker
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/smile_stalker
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/golden_stalker
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/twixels_jester
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/jester_grin
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/jester_window_peek
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/jester_door_peek
/function pngstalksafe:spawn/all
/function pngstalksafe:kill_all
